parsed.explanation: The combined operative regime is permissive: decriminalised same-sex conduct, marriage/adoption equality, legal gender recognition without surgery, X/indeterminate markers, gender-identity-inclusive anti-discrimination cover in goods and services in every state, hate-crime aggravation, and a police-bias duty. Detention has a documented framework including gender self-determination, with a 2025 justice-ministry authority available. No traveler-facing restriction (border, facility, custody, care) is documented. Deductions come from documented societal hostility — a 2025 neo-Nazi luring network, 1,575 prejudice-violence victims (under-recorded, no denominators, trans share unresolved) — and a far-right political rise. Police arrested the network's perpetrators, showing state response functioning.

entry_documents.exposure: No border or document friction documented; X/indeterminate markers constitutionally recognised (2018 ruling).
entry_documents.protection: Gender identity accurately reflected in official documents per Constitutional Court; visitors' home documents govern.
entry_documents.interaction: Marker recognition at home-country level interacts smoothly with entry checks; no mismatch penalty documented.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Specific housing rules for a detained trans visitor sit in an untranslated German parliamentary answer; content unresolved.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: 2025 national report on LGBTIQ detainees covers legal framework, gender self-determination and anti-discrimination in prisons; justice ministry is citable authority.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: A visitor arrested in the hate-crime context would enter this framework; exact placement rules uncertain pending the source.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: No facility exclusion (bathroom, ward, custody-by-birth-sex) documented anywhere in the record.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Goods-and-services anti-discrimination protection extended across every state/province since January 2017.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Uniform national floor removes state-by-state variation for a visitor moving between provinces.

care_services.exposure: Psychiatric-opinion conditions on legal change and insured treatment are resident-facing; no visitor care denial documented.
care_services.protection: National psychiatric/gynaecological societies endorse puberty blockers; equal treatment cover includes sex characteristics.
care_services.interaction: An accompanying minor's care access is not documented as restricted for visitors.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Far-right party won most votes in 2024; governing centre-right historically opposed LGBT rights — climate signal, no operative hostile rule documented.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: 1993 Security Police Act bars biased police action; hate speech banned since 2016 with aggravation at sentencing.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Political shift could weaken future enforcement but has not produced documented traveler-facing rules.

minors_guardians.exposure: Outside sex-education providers restricted by education ministry; conversion-therapy ban remains a non-binding resolution.
minors_guardians.protection: 2018 conversion-therapy workshops banned regionally and the association prohibited nationally in 2019; all parties backed the ban vote.
minors_guardians.interaction: A travelling parent with a minor faces no documented family-law or custody exposure.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Documented 2025 neo-Nazi dating-app ambush network (17+ victims, likely more); 1,575 prejudice-violence victims in 2025, under-recorded; homophobic offences rising.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Police arrested 15 perpetrators aged 14–26; investigators pursued the network — state on victims' side. Transphobic incidents reportedly declined.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Network's victims described as gay/bisexual men; trans-specific targeting unresolved, but visibly trans foreigners share the exposure window.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Hate-crime counts lack per-capita and trans breakdown; justice-ministry detention answer untranslated; two sources yielded nothing.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Equal Treatment Act covers gender identity/expression/sex characteristics; Ombuds guidance on inclusive forms; open advocacy and community infrastructure.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Remedies are documented as in force and used (prosecutions), reducing weight of unknowns.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar: equality-law cover, functioning complaints, isolated friction. Lower than 0.85-A because this record documents an organised 2025 hate-violence network, under-recorded prejudice violence at scale, and a far-right largest-party election result — hostility elements 0.85-A lacks.

Higher than 0.75-C: no secondary-screening, detention or document-mismatch friction is documented here at all, and anti-discrimination cover is national and multi-state, versus 0.75-C's officer discretion and unclear guidance at remote crossings.

Materially higher than 0.65-A: that anchor has an actual document-mismatch detention of a visitor and inconsistent rural enforcement; this dossier documents no traveler detention incident, plus stronger statutory protections and successful prosecutions of attackers.

parsed.synthesis: Law and institutions align in acceptance: recognition without surgery, X markers, nationwide goods-and-services protection, hate-crime aggravation, and a police-bias duty, with no traveler-facing restriction on the record. Rule of law operates for trans people here — arrests of the 2025 ambush network and published detention frameworks are documented recourse, not paper. The deductions are societal and political: an active neo-Nazi luring network, under-recorded prejudice violence, and a far-right plurality. Those raise everyday street exposure for an outed visitor, but the state's response is prosecutorial, and no universal-exposure measure (border, facility, custody, care) is documented. Uncertainty about detention housing rules and trans-specific hate-crime magnitude keeps the score below the 0.85 tier.
